title: Accelerations under field
description: Essential: Correctly states the accelerations of the block (2 m/s²) and plate (8 m/s²) while the electric field is on.

title: Velocities at t=2s
description: Important: Calculates the velocities of the block (4 m/s) and plate (16 m/s) at the moment the electric field is removed.

title: Post-field accelerations
description: Important: Correctly determines the accelerations after the field is removed (block: 2 m/s², plate: -10 m/s²).

title: Equal velocity magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly finds the common speed (6 m/s) when the block and plate velocities become equal after the field is off.

title: Relative displacement calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the total relative displacement (18 m) as the length of the colored trace.

title: Force balance on plate
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to the plate, accounting for electric force and both friction forces correctly.

title: Kinematics application
description: Optional: Uses correct kinematic equations to find displacements for both objects in both phases of motion.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of friction forces or accelerations, leading to wrong signs in equations.

title: Friction force confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses the wrong coefficient (e.g., μ2 for block-plate friction) or omits a friction force in the force balance.
